text: Who reads a space: everyone, every account, or only its people; the server sets the default
description:
Felix 2026-11-20, for a second, personal server (ideas.entour.fyi) shared with a friend: reading must need an account there by default, while the Commons Hub server stays readable by everyone. This reverses "no private graphs" from 2026-11-12 (8faf6a70) as a per-server and per-space setting.

server.json guestDefaults.read: everyone | accounts | selected. A space's owner overrides it for the space; with "selected" only the space's people read it (owner, managers, writers, readers, server admins). A visitor who may not read is told to log in; an account that may not is told to ask the owner. Nothing of an unreadable space reaches the viewer, not even notes or its entry in the list of spaces.

status.comment: 1aee99ba (2026-11-20). auth/access.ts mayRead in assertAllowed for every request naming a graph; graphs.list filtered; the setting in Server settings and Space settings. Evidence: backend auth/read-access.test.ts (6 tests: visitor asked to log in, selected readers, one space opened to everyone, token limited to other graphs, admin default, discarded account leaves readers). Live on ideas.entour.fyi (read: accounts) since 2026-11-20.
